Description.Name: InBlue
Description.Details: The InBlue's story is less of a story about it's various owners (it trades hands quite frequently) and more about the InBlue itself. The story starts somewhere on New Kent, where InBlue was originally built as a standard BP-1 Black Python battlemech and assigned to a garrison cluster as expected. Somewhere along the line, the InBlue would find it's way to the Inner Sphere, where it would fall into the hands of a mercenary company who would run it stock until said company went bankrupt. During the liquidation proceedings, a stable ran by a man only known as 'Ray' would acquire the 'mech, and it would receive it's alterations (these alterations would be aimed primarily at high-speed close range combat). While the stable, along with 'Ray' would go under, the InBlue would frequently appear in matches to deadly effect with various stables and pilots. While it's performances would be well recieved, the 'mech began to be considered jinxed, as it's various owners frequently have to sell get rid of it in order to deal with sudden financial problems. This led some to view the 'mech as 'difficult', with some of the more superstitious types suspecting the 'mech itself being behind the various financial woes of it's various owners.
